author: saltoparticipation
title: Call for Illustrators - SALTO Participation
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. We are open to different styles and want to give the selected illustrator plenty of creative freedom to bring their own ideas and artistic identity to the collection. 🌍 Open to illustrators worldwide 💶 Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment 🎨 Approximately 10–15 original illustrations 📅 Application deadline: 8 November 2026 ✅ Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026 🚫 Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. A simple sketch, rough concept, or mood board is enough. We do not expect substantial unpaid creative work. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio Know an illustrator whose work could bring a fresh perspective to participation? Share this call with them!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: factornotes
title: Hiring Illustrator for Stationery and Campaigns
content: At Factor Notes, we love turning creative ideas into visuals that inspire, connect and tell a story. We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. If you have a passion for illustration, a distinctive creative approach and an eye for bringing concepts to life through visuals, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do: Illustration & Artwork: Create original illustrations and artwork for our stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns. Concept Development: Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters and visual elements that align with our brand identity. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with the design, content and marketing teams to develop visuals that tell a cohesive brand story. Creative Exploration: Experiment with illustration styles and contribute fresh ideas for product launches, seasonal collections and marketing campaigns. Who You Are: Experienced: Have 0–3 years of experience in illustration or a related creative field, supported by a strong portfolio of original work. Technical Proficiency: Be proficient in digital illustration tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Procreate. Creative Expertise: Have a strong understanding of colour theory, composition and visual storytelling, along with excellent attention to detail. Interested in joining our team? Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com
